_comment: Portable reference set of MCP servers for the D55 toolchain. The engine diffs a developer's mcp.json against this and merges in only what's missing. Machine/user/secret bits are placeholders ({{...}}) resolved per developer at setup time — never copy absolute paths, emails, or tokens from one machine to another.

playwright.notes: Headless browser automation + screenshots (used by deliverables verification, screen-mockups).

placeholders.env_file: Absolute path to the gitignored atlassian.env in the target workspace. Default: <workspace>/.kiro/settings/atlassian.env
placeholders.JIRA_URL: Atlassian site URL. D55 team default: https://d55ltd.atlassian.net

secrets.notes: JIRA_API_TOKEN lives ONLY in the --env-file (matched by .kiro/settings/*.env in .gitignore). Never place the token in mcp.json and never print it. Create a token at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens.

atlassian.notes: Jira via mcp-atlassian. The command resolves to the uvx on the target's PATH (do not hardcode another machine's absolute uvx path).
